$Comment: The Grove Warden, the surviving uncorrupted Kweebec who sends players into a round. Standing
beside the spawn point of the ordinary world, this is the diegetic way into Kweebec Nightmare:
press F to hear the backstory and pick a preset.
Where: the world named 'default', which is the persistent world players log into, never a round
instance and never the creative hub. A bare word under Match is an exact name, so if your main
world is called something else, change it here or the Warden appears nowhere. Anchor: that
world's own spawn point, shifted 5 blocks along X so the Warden stands beside the arrival spot
rather than on top of it, facing 90 degrees.
Requires: the Warden stands only where MMO Skill Tree is NOT installed. A server running both
mods has its own guide at spawn already, so a second character offering a different thing beside
them reads as clutter; there, place the Warden deliberately with the native NPC spawn tooling,
somewhere that suits your world. Max 0 is how 'that mod is absent' is written: the reading
answers 1 when the named mod is loaded and 0 when it is not, so an upper bound of 0 passes only
on a server without it. To have the Warden appear at spawn on a server running both, put a file
of your own with this same id in a pack and leave the Requires block out of it.
Lifecycle: KeepAlive holds the Warden's chunk in memory so players can always find them, Respawn
places them again if something removes them, and Fortify raises their health far beyond anything
that can be dealt. Fortify matters because a role's Invulnerable flag does not cover a direct
health write, and an entry NPC that can be killed takes every player's way into a round with
them.
There is no Interact block here on purpose: the KweebecNightmare_Guide role opens the conversation
itself, so pressing F behaves the same whether this placement stood the Warden up or an admin
spawned one by hand. To change what the Warden opens, edit that role.
To move the Warden, edit Anchor. To stop them appearing, set Enabled false here, or leave this
file untouched and switch it off in mods/ziggfreedcommon/npc-placements.json.
Name: Kweebec_Grove_Warden
